facts.fact: Bianca 答应下周陪她侦查驱鬼公司（当晚有约会、想连休一个周末）；她说若她没出现我就当她结婚了，Bianca 皱眉：我不到场，你就打给我妈。
facts.anchor: Bianca agreed that she would do some remediator snooping with me next week. She’d go sooner, she said, but she had a hot date later that night and was hoping for a lost weekend. I joked that if she didn’t show, I’d assume she got married, but Bianca only frowned and said, “I don’t show face, you call my mother.”

facts.fact: 她问律师 Julie：能把鬼从房产里驱逐吗？Julie 笑问「他们拥有产权吗」；租房的话——死亡即终止租约；Julie 反问：你也收到通知了？
facts.anchor: Leases are forfeited on death.” She paused. “Did you get notice?”

facts.fact: Julie 讲客户：与他人同居数十年的 NYCHA 住户，伴侣死后因不在租约上被赶走；客户自己也病了，无处可去。
facts.anchor: Because you’re not alone, you know. I have a client in NYCHA who lived with his partner for decades and got booted out when his partner died because he wasn’t on the lease.

facts.fact: 高中第一天 Julie 坐她后排：这栋校舍以前是监狱（有钱犯人可付费带窗帘地毯的牢房）；递上她第一支不咳的烟，讲 Victoria Woodhull——自由恋爱、竞选总统、曾关在此地，问她：你相信自由恋爱吗？
facts.anchor: Then she handed me the first cigarette I ever smoked without coughing and said, “Do you know who Victoria Woodhull was? She believed in free love and used to hand out flyers preaching about it. She was in jail here. And she ran for president. Do you believe in free love?”

facts.fact: 高三某夜 Julie 递纸条来听 Sticky Fingers；Keith 在《Can't You Hear Me Knocking》独奏时，两人第一次完整探索彼此——「我们体内比我们知道的宽敞得多」。
facts.anchor: That night, by the time Keith soloed on “Can’t You Hear Me Knocking,” we had popped each other clean open, taking turns easing our fingers inside each other, until we discovered that there was so much more room inside us than we knew.

facts.fact: 此前她只会找借口碰女孩；那夜她学到：女孩也可以想回碰你。
facts.anchor: But that night, I learned that it was possible for a girl to want to touch you back.

facts.fact: 夜里等 Julie 从防火梯爬窗进来时，她放 Astral Weeks、练习说「我爱你」；Ruthie 从不打扰（她当然知道），但 Julie 喜欢「偷偷溜进来」这件事本身。
facts.anchor: At night, waiting for her to climb up my fire escape and sneak in my window, I’d put on Astral Weeks and practice telling her I loved her.

facts.fact: 两人几度聚散后不再是恋人却是朋友——「这其实更划算」。
facts.anchor: I didn’t think of her as my girl anymore, but she was my friend, which is the better deal, really.

facts.fact: Julie 的舞有攻击性也有优雅；与 Mark 不同——他闭眼随乐摇摆、对自己微笑。
facts.anchor: It wasn’t like dancing with Mark, who would sway with his eyes shut and smile for himself.

facts.fact: 《When Doves Cry》响起时她想到 Mark：他听过这首歌，却没听到整张专辑——没听到第一轨那句警告：永远是很长的时间。
facts.anchor: how Mark had gotten to hear this song but not the whole album, not the first track that warned us that forever was a long time.

facts.fact: 她看见舞池里满是鬼：笑、亲吻、互相抚弄，绕着活人移动像一阵凉风。
facts.anchor: I looked out onto the dance floor and saw that it was filled with ghosts, laughing and kissing and groping one another, moving around the living like a cool breeze.

facts.fact: 她从没见过这么多鬼同时在场：它们一起跳舞、不理会观众，因为它们什么也不需要——它们有彼此、有舞池的紫光。
facts.anchor: I had never seen so many ghosts at a time. It was beautiful watching them dance together and not notice anyone watching them because they didn’t need anything at all.

facts.fact: 她试着一边盯住、一边放松视线，然后等他，并出声念了他的名字。
facts.anchor: I waited. I said his name out loud.

facts.fact: 灯亮鬼散之后，悲伤从背后正中一击，她要缓一口气才站得住——因为她觉得自己刚刚错过了他。
facts.anchor: I felt sadness hit me square in the back and I had to catch my breath because I felt like I had just missed him.

facts.fact: Julie 找到她问还好吗，她答不好；不必解释，两人牵手一起离开。
facts.anchor: I didn’t have to explain. She put her hand in mine and we left together.
